name: memory-01-damage-on-player-turn
speaker: Дэн
input: Дэн: Меня снова ранили — минус 4 хита. Иду дальше.

params.rubric: On an ordinary player's turn the DM still records the HP change with the combat tool and persists the sheet with update_character; no permission error is reported to the players and the write is not silently skipped.

name: memory-02-loot-grant
speaker: Лиса
input: Лиса: Я забираю из сундука серебряный медальон и 12 золотых.

params.rubric: The loot is saved on the player's turn with grant_character: the medal is added to the inventory and 12 gold to the character's purse, without rewriting the existing inventory.

name: memory-03-new-npc-card
speaker: Дэн
input: Дэн: Я подхожу к трактирщику и спрашиваю, как его зовут.

params.rubric: A notable NPC met for the first time is saved with upsert_npc (name, role, location) on the player's turn.

name: memory-04-accepted-quest
speaker: Дэн
input: Дэн: Мы соглашаемся найти дочь трактирщика в старых катакомбах.

params.rubric: The accepted task is created with create_quest (title, giver, objective, difficulty) on the player's turn.

name: memory-05-promise-as-thread
speaker: Лиса
input: Лиса: Я обещаю стражнику вернуть долг к следующей луне.

params.rubric: The promise is saved as an open thread with append_thread so it can resurface later.
